summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native VALEO app fully tested via mobile web preview (390x844). All 22 critical flows PASSED: login screen renders (both cards), coop patron login lands on Bilan, patron nav (bilan/planteurs/FAB/collaborateurs/coop) works, Dashboard shows collected kg / KPIs / pending loans banner / recent collections, Planteurs list + member detail opens, Pesée sheet opens via FAB with planteur Select working, Coop -> coop-loans -> approve/refuse pending loans works, Équipe tab shows add-collab and existing collaborateurs, Settings sheet opens via topbar-settings, logout returns to login, planteur login lands on Mes poids with Mobile Money nav. No red screens, no console errors (only a deprecation warning about 'shadow*' style props from RN Web). No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in react-native-web — consider migrating shadow* to boxShadow or wrapping platform-specific styles. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* style props (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) to Platform.select or boxShadow to silence RN Web warning (see index.tsx FAB style around line 76).
PDF generation (Partager PDF / Imprimer buttons in Bordereau) not exercised in web preview — expected to only work on native build; validate on APK build.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx (~240 lines) and sheets.tsx/screens.tsx architecture look modular; no obvious DRY/violations spotted.

All interactive elements have testID as promised (nav-*, fab, save-btn, select-trigger, select-option-*, add-member, add-collab, member-<id>, collab-<id>, coop-loans, loan-approve-*, sheet-close, topbar-settings, topbar-logout, photo-avatar). Great coverage.
Offline-only, no backend calls made — confirmed no /api requests fired during the flow.
AsyncStorage persistence: seed data loaded and persisted between actions (loan approvals reflected immediately).
seed_data_creation: None — used preloaded demo seed (M. Diomandé patron, Awa Touré commis, Bakary Coulibaly pisteur; 5 planteurs including Kouassi Yao, Amoin Adjoua, Gnamien Koffi, Aya Brou).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://app-deploy-187.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Dropdowns are custom modal Selects — click [data-testid="select-trigger"] then [data-testid="select-option-<value>"] (do NOT use native select_option). Two Selects on Login page: index 0 = coop staff, index 1 = planteur. Multiple 'Se connecter' save-btns — use has_text filter and .last for the planteur one. FAB triggers pesee sheet for coop, loan sheet for planteur. Bordereau close via [data-testid="bordereau-close"]. Seed loads instantly (no LLM latency).
